title: Set up the PERMAFLEET voice channel
description: Gives a member org a public PERMAFLEET voice channel, open to every PERMAFLEET pilot. goon.vc's bot creates it, or the server's own channel is used.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Every PERMAFLEET member org keeps a public **PERMAFLEET** voice channel, open to every PERMAFLEET pilot, so anyone in the alliance can drop in and fly with you. Let's set one up on **{{context.guildName}}**.

channel.say: Should goon.vc's bot create the PERMAFLEET voice channel? That's the recommended way: it's set up the same on every member org's Discord. Or pick a voice channel **{{context.guildName}}** already has.

category.say: Which category should it go in? It stays open to everyone on your server, whatever the category allows.

permissions.say:
To create the voice channel, goon.vc's bot needs **Manage Channels**, plus the permissions it opens up there. Missing on **{{context.guildName}}** right now: {{context.channelMissing}}.
Grant them with this link (it updates the bot if it's already in your server), then press Continue: {{context.channelInviteUrl}}

summary.say:
Here's the plan for **{{context.guildName}}**:
- Create a PERMAFLEET voice channel everyone on your server can join and talk in
- Category: {{labels.category|none, top of the channel list}}

Go ahead?

existing.say:
I'll use {{labels.channel}} as the PERMAFLEET voice channel on **{{context.guildName}}** and leave its permissions as they are. Every PERMAFLEET pilot should be able to join it.

Go ahead?

complete.say: {{labels.result}} PERMAFLEET pilots can drop in any time. Run `/goon voice` again any time.

cancelled.say: Nothing changed. Run `/goon voice` in your server to start again.
